verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a comprehensive public API surface — Ingestion API, Query API, Raw Event/Engage Export APIs, Feature Flags API, and JQL for custom queries — giving an AI-native user multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent/hands-on corroboration of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
